checks.text: The page shows the heading "Kanban Board" and three columns with the visible labels "To Do", "In Progress", and "Done".

Clicking the button "Add card" in the column "To Do" opens a card editor; typing "Write spec" in the field labelled "Title" and clicking "Save" adds a card containing "Write spec" to the "To Do" column.
After adding the card "Write spec" to "To Do", the WIP count displayed in the "To Do" column header shows "1".
Clicking the card "Write spec" in "To Do" opens the card editor; changing the field labelled "Title" to "Write final spec" and clicking "Save" updates the card text to "Write final spec".
Dragging the card "Write final spec" from the "To Do" column to the "In Progress" column moves the card; the "To Do" column WIP count shows "0" and the "In Progress" column WIP count shows "1".
Clicking the button "Delete card" on the card "Write final spec" in "In Progress" removes the card; the "In Progress" column WIP count shows "0".

Clicking the button "Add card" in "In Progress", typing "Review code" in the field labelled "Title", and clicking "Save" adds a card "Review code" to "In Progress"; the WIP count in "In Progress" shows "1".
Clicking the button "Export JSON" copies a JSON string to the clipboard that includes the text "Write final spec" if that card exists, or an empty array if no cards exist.
Reload keeps the card "Review code" in the "In Progress" column with the WIP count "1".
